usage: 白切雞飯 is a noun referring to a dish consisting of plain boiled chicken served with rice.
You can use 白切雞飯 to order food in a restaurant or mention a specific menu item.
When talking about meals or preferences, 白切雞飯 can be the subject or object of a sentence.
In conversations, 白切雞飯 is often combined with other food or drink items to express a full meal choice.
Use 白切雞飯 in casual or formal situations when discussing Cantonese food.
